# Site Links Analysis — architecture.novatrek.cc

**Date:** 2026-05-11
**Build inspected:** `portal/site/` (231 HTML pages, 28 MB, generated by `bash portal/scripts/generate-all.sh` + `mkdocs build`)
**Method:** Custom Python crawler (`/tmp/linkcheck.py`) that parses every page in `portal/site/`, resolves `<a href>`, `<img src>`, `<object data>`, `<link href>`, `<script src>`, `<iframe src>` against the filesystem, and verifies fragment anchors against `id="…"`, `id='…'`, and unquoted `id=…` attributes (necessary because `mkdocs-minify-plugin` emits unquoted attributes).

> **Important methodology note:** an initial pass that only matched quoted `id="…"` reported 10,640 broken in-page anchors. Once the regex was extended to handle minified unquoted attributes, that number collapsed to **14**. The huge "missing TOC anchor" finding from the first pass was a false positive of the checker, not a real defect. The numbers below are from the corrected pass.

---

## Headline Numbers

| Category | Count | Severity | Real defect? |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `missing_link` (favicon `<link href>`) | 181 | High visibility — every page | Yes |
| `fragment_missing` (cross-page anchors, mostly Swagger) | 160 | Medium — broken deep links | Yes |
| `missing_a` (broken `<a href>` to other pages or `.md` files) | 147 | Medium — broken navigation | Yes |
| `fragment_missing_self` (in-page anchors that don't exist) | 14 | Low | Yes — but tiny |
| `missing_img` | 3 | Low — template scaffolding only | Cosmetic |
| **Total broken references** | **505** | | |

Out of **49,969** total references examined across **231** pages — roughly **1.0 %** broken. Not catastrophic, but four of the five categories are systemic and can be fixed with a single change each.

---

## Issue 1 — Favicon: 181 broken `<link rel=icon>` (every page)

### Symptom

Every page emits `<link rel=icon href=…/assets/favicon.png>` with depth-relative paths (`assets/favicon.png`, `../assets/favicon.png`, `../../assets/favicon.png`, etc.). None of those targets exist in the build output.

### Root cause

[portal/mkdocs.yml](portal/mkdocs.yml#L16) declares:

```yaml
theme:
  favicon: assets/favicon.png
```

…but no source file exists at `portal/docs/assets/favicon.png`. There is no `portal/docs/assets/` directory at all.

```
$ find portal/docs -iname "favicon*"
(empty)

$ find . -iname "favicon*"
./portal/site/assets/images/favicon.png    <-- Material theme default, copied by build
./.venv/lib/python3.9/site-packages/material/templates/assets/images/favicon.png
```

The Material theme ships a default favicon at `assets/images/favicon.png`, which is what the build copies, but `mkdocs.yml` overrides the theme to point at `assets/favicon.png` instead — a path that has never existed in this repo.

### Git history

The bad path was introduced in the **very first commit** that added the portal:

```
24b10dd2  Add initial files for NovaTrek Architecture Portal
```

It has never been correct. Browsers silently fall back to no favicon (or a 404), so it has gone unnoticed.

### Affected pages

All 231 pages.

---

## Issue 2 — Cross-service navigation from `architect-guide/domain-model/`: 60+ broken `<a>`

### Symptom

`/architect-guide/domain-model/` (the page with 43 broken links — the worst page on the site) has links such as:

- `<a href="../microservices/svc-check-in/">` → resolves to `/architect-guide/microservices/svc-check-in/` ❌ (correct: `/microservices/svc-check-in/`)
- `<a href="../microservices/svc-scheduling-orchestrator/">`
- `<a href="../microservices/svc-guest-profiles/">`
- … 18 distinct service URLs, each broken

### Root cause

[portal/docs/architect-guide/domain-model.md](portal/docs/architect-guide/domain-model.md#L19) source:

```markdown
| **[Operations](../domains/operations.md)** | [svc-check-in](../microservices/svc-check-in/), …
```

This is a classic MkDocs `use_directory_urls: true` (default) pitfall:

- Source file lives at `portal/docs/architect-guide/domain-model.md`
- After build it renders at `/architect-guide/domain-model/index.html`
- Relative path `../microservices/...` resolves from `/architect-guide/domain-model/`, going **up one level only** — to `/architect-guide/microservices/...`
- The actual target is `/microservices/...`, which requires `../../microservices/...`

The author wrote the link as if the page lived at root, not nested under `architect-guide/`.

### Git history

```
e495d7d0  docs(portal): add comprehensive Architect's Guide top-level section
4d4726b4  feat(portal): add ~120 cross-links across hand-authored pages and solution generator
c6dcfbb3  docs(portal): link service domains to detailed domain views
4ca03de8  feat(portal): add top-level Domains section with generated detail pages
```

The `e495d7d0` "Architect's Guide" commit moved the page into the nested `architect-guide/` directory. The relative paths were not updated to add the extra `..`.

### Affected pages

`/architect-guide/domain-model/` (43 broken links — the single worst page on the site). May affect any other hand-authored page nested one level deep that references `../microservices/…`, `../decisions/…`, `../events/…`, or `../services/…`.

## Issue 3 — Swagger UI deep-link fragments: 160 broken cross-page anchors

### Symptom

Microservice pages link from sequence diagrams or endpoint tables to specific operations in the Swagger UI viewer:

```
../../services/api/svc-emergency-response.html#/Emergencies/triggerEmergency
../../services/api/svc-wildlife-tracking.html#/Sightings/reportSighting
../../services/api/svc-safety-compliance.html#/Waivers/signWaiver
```

The HTML files exist (the `.html` portion resolves), but the `#/Tag/operationId` fragment never matches an `id` in the rendered Swagger UI page.

### Root cause

The portal's Swagger UI viewer pages (under `services/api/`) are generated from the OpenAPI specs. Swagger UI renders operation anchors using one of a few formats depending on version and config — the most common being:

- `#/Tag/operationId` (older Swagger UI)
- `#operations-Tag-operationId` (Swagger UI ≥ 3.x default)
- `#tag/Tag/operation/operationId` (Redoc)

Whatever generator wrote `services/api/svc-*.html` is producing a page whose anchor format does not match what the microservice generator (`portal/scripts/generate-microservice-pages.py`) embeds in deep links. The two sides agreed on a fragment convention that is not what the viewer actually emits.

### Affected pages

160 deep links across the 24 microservice pages, mostly the newer ones (`svc-emergency-response`, `svc-wildlife-tracking`, `svc-safety-compliance`, `svc-trip-catalog`, etc.). Note: there are now **24** generated microservice pages (the original 19 from the documented domain model plus `svc-emergency-response`, `svc-wildlife-tracking`, `svc-reviews`, `svc-adventure-tracking`, and one more) — the new ones emit more deep links per page than the older ones, which is why they account for most of the breakage.

## Issue 4 — Dangling `.md` and out-of-portal references: 147 broken `<a>`

### Symptom

Pages contain raw `.md`-suffixed links and links into directories that are not part of the MkDocs nav. Top offenders:

| Frequency | Broken href | Source page |
|---:|---|---|
| 4 | `../research/CONFLUENCE-PUBLISHING-PLAN.md` | [portal/docs/roadmap.md](portal/docs/roadmap.md) |
| 3 | `/.ai-instructions/customizations/solution-design-optional-sections-standard.md` | (multiple) |
| 2 | `../docs/CALM-INTEGRATION-PLAN.md` | (multiple) |
| 2 | `../architecture/reminders/CALM-EVALUATION.md` | (multiple) |
| 2 | `SYNTHETIC-EXEMPLAR-BACKLOG.md` | [TRANSFORMATION-PLAN.md](portal/docs/everything-as-code/TRANSFORMATION-PLAN.md), [index.md](portal/docs/everything-as-code/index.md) |
| 2 | `DEEP-RESEARCH-PROMPT-EAC-MATURITY-MODEL-RESPONSE.md` | [DEEP-RESEARCH-PROMPT-EAC-MATURITY-MODEL.md](portal/docs/everything-as-code/DEEP-RESEARCH-PROMPT-EAC-MATURITY-MODEL.md) |
| 2 | `README.md` | (multiple) |
| 2 | `../phase-1-ai-tool-cost-comparison/workspace/work-items/tickets/_NTK-10004-…/NTK-10004-solution-design.md` | (multiple) |
| 2 | `../services/svc-scheduling-orchestrator.md`, `../services/svc-check-in.md` | (legacy path) |
| 1 each | `../microservices/svc-referral-engine.md`, `svc-campaign-management.md`, `../events/index.md`, `../decisions/README.md`, ADR files, `TEST-METHODOLOGY-ROADMAP.md` | (various) |

Three sub-problems:

1. **Repo-relative paths leaked into portal docs.** Some authors wrote `../research/X.md`, `../docs/Y.md`, or `../architecture/reminders/Z.md` — these point outside `portal/docs/` to the source repo and have no portal equivalent.
2. **`.md` suffix not stripped.** Internal links like `SYNTHETIC-EXEMPLAR-BACKLOG.md` and `README.md` would work if the file were in nav (MkDocs would rewrite the suffix), but they are not — the linked files were never published.
3. **Stale references to renamed/deleted services.** `svc-referral-engine`, `svc-campaign-management`, and the legacy `services/svc-*.md` paths point to pages that no longer exist (services were renamed to the `svc-` prefix and moved under `microservices/`).

### Git history

These accumulated across several commits. The biggest contributor is `4d4726b4 feat(portal): add ~120 cross-links across hand-authored pages and solution generator` and `8e16bd9a fix: correct broken solution design links on microservice pages` — neither of which validated targets after writing.

## Issue 5 — In-page TOC anchors: 14 broken self-fragments

### Symptom

Two distinct sub-problems:

**5a. Footnote back-references (12 broken):**
```
/security/research-prompt-response/  -> #fnref:4
…  -> #fnref:5, #fnref:11, #fnref:14, #fnref:20, #fnref:27, #fnref:38,
       #fnref:41, #fnref:49, #fnref:51, #fnref:57, #fnref:58
```
The `pymdownx` footnotes extension only generates one `fnref:N` back-link per footnote. When the same footnote is cited multiple times (e.g., footnote 4 cited at 3 places), the extension emits `fnref:4`, `fnref:4:1`, `fnref:4:2` — but the back-link from the footnote itself only points to `fnref:4`. The other citations have no back-link target. This is a known footnotes-extension behavior, not a bug we introduced.

**5b. Solution-page "Architecture Decisions" anchor missing (2 broken):**
```
/solutions/_NTK-10005-wristband-rfid-field/  -> #architecture-decisions
/solutions/_NTK-10001-add-elevation-to-trail-response/  -> #architecture-decisions
```
The solution generator emits a link to `#architecture-decisions` but the heading slug it actually produces is different (likely lower-cased differently or the heading was renamed). Easy fix in `portal/scripts/generate-solution-pages.py`.

## Issue 6 — Missing template assets: 3 broken `<img>`

[portal/docs/standards/solution-design/solution-design-template.md](portal/docs/standards/solution-design/solution-design-template.md) embeds three placeholder diagrams that don't exist:

```
3.solution/00.component.diagram.svg
3.solution/01b.[component].[workflow].sequence.diagram.target.svg
3.solution/02b.[component].[workflow].sequence.diagram.target.svg
```

These are template scaffolding showing what a solution should contain. Either replace with a "diagram placeholder" SVG or wrap in a code block so they render as filenames, not images.

## What is NOT broken

To set expectations correctly:

- **All page-to-page navigation in the MkDocs `nav:` is intact.** No 404s on actual pages indexed in the navigation.
- **All 302 generated SVG sequence diagrams render and the embedded clickable links inside them resolve.**
- **All `<script>` and `<link rel=stylesheet>` references work.**
- **The Confluence mirror is unaffected** — it strips `<object>` and rewrites links during the `confluence-prepare.py` stage, so its link surface is different.
- **Heading anchors work site-wide.** The initial alarm about >10,000 missing in-page anchors was a false positive caused by the link checker not handling `mkdocs-minify-plugin`'s unquoted HTML attributes.
